author: draganrakita
content: It is not if clients will use it, but if fv is going to be good enough and easy to use. It is a lot different if it has potential or it is it is already made (Experiment is a lot different from production). So, when fv gets a lot better and few good examples are made that prove its efficiency, naturally clients will gravitate towards it (Thinking in reverse is not helpful).
